comment: Declarative registry of every third-party asset. Nothing binary is committed:
`npm run assets:fetch` downloads into public/assets/, verifies the hash, and
regenerates CREDITS.md. `npm run assets:verify` runs in CI and fails on an
unlicensed entry, a missing attribution, or a hash mismatch.
sha256 null means the hash has not been recorded yet. Run
`npm run assets:fetch -- --record` on a machine that can reach the host and
the hash is written back here, pinning the file from then on.
required:false assets are optional. The renderer falls back to procedural
geometry when they are absent, so the site always builds and always runs.
role tells the runtime what an asset is FOR. Only assets with a role the
app asks for are ever downloaded by the browser; everything else is
reference material that the fetch script pins but the page never requests.
The rally-kit URLs are pinned to a commit, not to main. A main URL would
drift and fail its own hash the next time upstream pushed.
kit.rally.atlas is the shared colour atlas that every one of those models
references by the RELATIVE path Textures/colormap.png. GLTFLoader resolves
that against the model's own URL, so the file has to land in a sibling
Textures/ directory next to them. Get it wrong and the models load white
rather than broken, which is a much easier failure to miss.

assets.title: Car Kit — race car
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: The player's kart. Wheel nodes are named wheel-front-left/right and wheel-back-left/right, which is what lets buildKart spin them. Exactly one manifest entry may carry role 'kart'. Swap the file for another Car Kit model to change the vehicle.

assets.title: Starter Kit Racing — colour atlas
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Shared by every rally-kit model, which reference it relatively. Never requested by id at runtime — it only has to be on disk beside the models — so it carries a role nothing asks for.

assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: A spectator camp, upgrading the procedural stands.

assets.title: Starter Kit Racing — start/finish gantry
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Stands over the chequered start line at the origin junction.

assets.title: Venice Sunset
assets.author: Greg Zaal, Poly Haven
assets.notes: Reference only, and not wired in: 1.4 MB is most of a page budget. Pinned here for the image-based-lighting item on the roadmap. Mirrored in the three.js repository because polyhaven.com is blocked by this environment's egress policy.

assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Round broadleaf. Replaces procedural tree variant 0. Meshopt-compressed with a baked 512px WebP leaf/bark texture; needs the Meshopt decoder registered in src/assets/loader.js.

assets.author: Kenney

assets.title: Car Kit — hatchback
assets.author: Kenney
assets.notes: Every moving vehicle. buildCars keeps the scaled instance items and re-seats them each frame from the traffic simulation; wheels do not spin (baked into the instanced geometry).

assets.author: ambientCG
assets.notes: ambientCG Grass001, 1K. ambientcg.com is blocked by this workspace's egress policy; this is the pmndrs/market-assets mirror on raw.githubusercontent.com, pinned to the commit that added it. The terrain samples it in world space, so it tiles across the torus seam.

assets.notes: Normal map for the same set. MeshLambertMaterial supports normalMap, which is what gives the flat ground its blade-level relief.
